name: Forced displacement
summary: IOM reports 15,310 newly displaced in Kordofan in November; no event displacing over 500,000 in a month found
state: IOM said on 27 Nov that more than 383,000 people were displaced from Sudan's Kordofan region between October 2025 and October 2026, with a further 15,310 displaced in November, mostly in West Kordofan (Mirage News, IOM). IOM has put displacement from renewed fighting in Yemen above 340,000 since August, and UNHCR said about 64,000 people have fled northern Nigeria to Niger this year (UN News). None amounts to a new event displacing 500,000 people in a month, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Large displacement is ongoing in Sudan, Yemen and the Sahel but is spread over months. People displaced by conflict face shelter, food and health gaps, and outflows tend to strain neighbouring countries first.
rubric_hit: Normal: no new event displacing >500,000 in a month — Kordofan 15,310 in Nov (IOM, 27 Nov)
